inspection_note: Whole image and both halves viewed before C/H, nine C doubt loci and inventory. All62 crop recipes displayed; the initial +25-degree margin rotation tilted the writing further, so a -25-degree upright view was added and read. Every agreed line, symbol, index, bar, deletion, insertion and mathematical sign checked against ink. Four C doubts resolved (tensor prefix, OU as two overlapping case bodies, celle-ci, la); remaining faint first star, adjective accent, marginal glyph and bidegree details stay qualified. New i/-i and letter-correction uncertainties are explicit. Extra parenthesis and rationelle follow visible ink also retained by H. Seven Q bodies and four o indices separately enlarged; the isolated repeated C follows the typed self-overstrike convention. Physical insertion/transposition guides, correction traces and folio are included. No OCR, parallel transcription, compilation, context access or mathematical correction.
